§3§lCoin sources§r
Ordinary Neko Coins are included in §17§r structure-chest loot tables, with §12–8§r coins per loot entry and a stack limit of §164§r. Shimmering Coins are not registered in those chest tables; sources include fishing, exchange trades and quest rewards.

§3§lFishing chances§r
Each successful catch first rolls the default §12%§r chance for a Shimmering Coin. If that misses, it rolls the default §110%§r chance for an ordinary coin. The resulting default ordinary-coin chance is §19.8%§r. Servers can adjust both chances.

§3§lCompletion§r
Hold §18§r ordinary Neko Coins for retrieval. They are §2not consumed§r.
